replies.who: I'm Murad Fataliyev — a frontend developer from Baku, Azerbaijan. I build fast, clean, and visually polished web experiences with React and Next.js, focused on clarity, performance, and user flow. More about me is in the About section below.
replies.projects: My selected work includes an open-air cinema platform with Telegram-powered notifications, a home services platform with AI-assisted routing, and a modern food delivery landing page. Each project has a live demo link in the Projects section.
replies.stack: I work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Vite, and Node.js — plus Supabase and Firebase on the backend side, and Figma for design. The full breakdown is in the Skills section.
replies.contact: The easiest way to reach me is through the Contact section at the bottom — my email and LinkedIn are there, and I usually reply within a day.

about.title: About me
about.body:
Frontend developer from Baku, passionate about building fast, clean, and visually polished web apps. I enjoy turning ideas into interfaces that feel modern, intuitive, and production-ready.

I care about responsive frontend architecture, clarity, performance, and the small details that shape a good user flow. I work across the modern React ecosystem — from landing pages and dashboards to bots and real-time features.

featured.title: Gala Garden Cinema
featured.description: Open-air cinema platform with a clean, responsive experience — movie exploration, food ordering, and real-time notifications powered by the Telegram Bot API.
featured.longDescription: A full platform built for an open-air cinema: visitors browse the movie catalog, pick a session, order snacks and drinks, and receive real-time updates about sessions and orders via the Telegram Bot API. The simple, clean interface turns the whole flow into a few effortless clicks.
features: Real-time notifications via Telegram Bot API

items.title: HəllVar
items.description: Online platform digitalizing the home services sector in Azerbaijan — customers describe their problem, an AI-assisted system routes it to the right category, they book verified technicians, chat in realtime, and leave reviews. Fully supported in 4 languages.
items.longDescription: A platform digitalizing the home services market: customers describe their problem, an AI-assisted system routes it to the right category, customers compare verified technicians and book them, follow progress in a realtime chat, and leave reviews when the job is done. The platform is fully supported in 4 languages.

items.title: Foodie
items.description: Modern food delivery landing page designed with a clear visual hierarchy, strong UI sections, and smooth frontend interactions.
items.longDescription: A modern food delivery landing page built around a strong visual hierarchy, clear call-to-action blocks, and smooth micro-interactions. State management with Redux Toolkit keeps the interface dynamic and fast.

items.q: What technologies do you work with?
items.a: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and Redux Toolkit — with Supabase and Firebase on the backend side and the Telegram Bot API for bots. The full breakdown is in the Skills section.

items.q: What kind of projects do you take on?
items.a: Landing pages, web applications, dashboards, and products with real-time features. I take on everything from small improvements to full products.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the size: a landing page takes 1–2 weeks, a full web app 2–8 weeks. The exact timeline is agreed after the first call.

items.q: What's the best way to reach you?
items.a: Via email or LinkedIn — I usually reply within a day. For freelance proposals, email is the most reliable option.
